target_customer: Patients and health systems (oral antiviral therapeutics for COVID-19 and other viruses)
problem: Oral antivirals were needed to treat and prevent SARS-CoV-2 infection, with broader viral targets.

founders.name: Uri Lopatin
founders.background_notes: Visiting partner at YC before founding Pardes

technical_complexity.rationale: Drug discovery and clinical development of a protease inhibitor needing trials and regulatory approval.

defensibility.rationale: Patents and trial data protect a candidate, but rivals with larger programs were ahead.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pfizer and Merck brought oral COVID antivirals to market ahead of Pardes; Pardes was taken private by MediPacific (controlled by key shareholders per a secondary source) at $2.13 per share in August 2023.

market_need_then: COVID-19 pandemic created a large unmet need for oral antivirals; a 2021 report named Pardes among developers that were further behind than Pfizer and Merck.

brand_strength.rationale: Biotech with no consumer brand; no brand evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Pardes was founded in 2020 by a veteran antiviral drug developer, raised a $52M Series A in February 2021 and listed through the FS Development Corp. II SPAC in December 2021 with a $75M PIPE. Pfizer and Merck's oral antivirals reached market first, and in August 2023 MediPacific bought Pardes for $2.13 per share in cash plus a contingent value right, far below the $10 SPAC price.
notes: Directory status says Public; the company was acquired by MediPacific and delisted in August 2023 (marketscreener; delisting from a single profile site). Founding was in 2020 but the Series A (Feb 2021) is the earliest round found. SPAC deal gross proceeds conflict: $201.2M expected (SPAC Insider), about $274M (Dealroom); not recorded as a round. The $75M PIPE closed with the 2021-12-23 merger. Acquisition price was $2.13 per share plus CVR; total deal amount not found. A single snippet says pomotrelvir (PBI-0451) missed a primary endpoint; unverified. No pre-2021 competitor source found; YC page confirms S20. Pfizer PF-07321332 Phase 1 (Mar 2021, tbsnews) postdates the batch and is recorded in market_need_then and takeover_risk_then; competition list left empty.
